items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: I say, TOMMY Tony, tell me. You people need money.

ctx.x: Something like that. Yeah, no, around '52, somewhere around there. So I'm going to the Palladium. All right. Play the Palladium. The business improved. Sunday was like a ball in there. They -- the white people coming down from -- and I say, TOMMY Tony, tell me. You people need money. I've got an idea. LATIN (Inaudible) people -- never had anyplace downtown -- Latin people, they, if we play for them on Sunday, they will
come over here. They don't go any place uptown. You think so? Palladium (inaudible). The people are going to be a class people (inaudible). So, all right, let me see what happens.
